en: Illustrated interior view of a large, crowded beer hall with vaulted, ornately painted ceilings and a huge circular chandelier. People in 19th‑century Central European clothing sit at long wooden tables drinking beer, while waitresses in traditional dresses serve them. In the background, wall paintings depict a cityscape. The image has a painterly style and a small caption printed along the lower edge.
